summary: IDS feed 'packet_drops' is degraded due to high packet loss (4.9% TCP gaps). No duplicates, one-way, VLAN or encryption issues detected. Loss causes incomplete stream reassembly for IDS.

findings.root_cause: Upstream capture/broker is dropping packets under load - 145 of 2933 TCP packets (4.9%, threshold 1%) show gaps/retransmissions. Tool overload check is healthy so drops are not at IDS ingress policing but at SPAN source or packet broker ingress/egress buffers overflowing on bursts, common with SPAN vs TAP.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires full payload and both directions for stream reassembly and signature matching. 4.9% missing data breaks TCP reassembly, causes missed exploits, fragmented file carving, and false negatives - detection coverage significantly reduced.

params.broker_action: verify broker ingress buffers and add selective filter if aggregate >1Gbps to fit IDS 1Gbps port

recommended_fix.why: TAP provides lossless, full-duplex copy without SPAN buffer drops or switch CPU contention. Eliminates the 4-5% random loss and ensures IDS receives complete flows for reliable detection. If TAP already in use, apply broker filtering/load-balancing to keep egress within 1Gbps.
